title: Card reader grants access but door stays locked
summary: The reader shows access granted, but the door does not release.
symptoms: Reader beeps or shows green on a valid card
Access granted events appear in the software

outline.title: Confirm the controller operates the lock output
outline.detail: Listen for the relay and check the output indicator on the controller, if fitted.

outline.title: Measure the lock supply at the lock
outline.detail: Check the voltage at the lock terminals while access is granted.

outline.title: Check the lock type and wiring match
outline.detail: Fail-safe and fail-secure locks are wired to opposite relay contacts.

outline.title: Check for mechanical binding
outline.detail: Door pressure on a strike keeper, or misalignment, can stop release.

verification.notes: Demonstration workflow outline. General fault-finding order only — follow the manufacturer's documentation and site procedures.
